selectionNote: All 500 samples were screened using existing pack scores. Thirty-four cases were visually reviewed at seven fixed frame positions against restored simulator GT and all 12 baseline configurations. Six recommended cases received an additional all-33-frame GT/WorldSync review. These are selected qualitative examples, not a representative performance estimate or task-success claims.

screening.method: Existing pack report-lineage pose NDTW and visual gates for triage; fixed-frame visual review determines recommendations. Lower pose error is better. No new evaluation run.
